title: Triangle laws for fixed-base etale cohomology pullback
statement: Given a scheme S, an abelian etale sheaf G on S [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and q≥0, with cohomology as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], assign to every commuting triangle X --f--> Y --a--> S with b=f a the homomorphism H^q(a⁻¹G)→H^q(b⁻¹G) obtained by cohomological pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] and the inverse-image composition isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. The identity triangle induces the identity homomorphism. For X --f--> Y --g--> Z over S, the map of the composite triangle is the composite of the two triangle maps. The triangle map sends the restriction of x in H^q(S,G) along a to its restriction along b.

proof.text: Apply the identity part of cohomologyPullbackFunctorial and upperStarComp_id_left to obtain the identity map.

Apply naturality and composition of cohomology pullback; combine the three sheaf morphisms using upperStarComp_hom_app_map_upperStarComp_inv_app_assoc, the component associativity coherence of inverse images. Cancel the comparison with its inverse.

lean.statement: theorem cohomologyTriangleMap_laws (S : Scheme.{u}) (G : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) : (∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (a : X ⟶ S), cohomologyTriangleMap (𝟙 X) a a (by simp) G q = AddMonoidHom.id _) ∧ (∀ (X Y Z : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (a : Z ⟶ S) (b : Y ⟶ S) (d : X ⟶ S) (hb : b = g ≫ a) (hd : d = f ≫ b), cohomologyTriangleMap (f ≫ g) a d (by rw [hd, hb, Category.assoc]) G q = (cohomologyTriangleMap f b d hd G q).comp (cohomologyTriangleMap g a b hb G q))
